// USE_SYNLIG_NOTE: GH #119 egt Bug 2 (bead gcd) root cause: Synlig/UHDM (USE_SYNLIG:true, LibreLane's default) mis-elaborates this candidate's shim -- the per-lane 'output 0 when active_mask_i[lane]=0' select mux (ui_cond_expr_FU at vector_alu_synth.v:346) loses its masking branch in the ASAP7-mapped netlist, leaking raw rs1_i/rs2_i straight into result_o for INACTIVE lanes. Proven by a SAT miter (yosys 0.46, real ASAP7 functional cell models parsed from the same liberty files LibreLane loads) between this candidate and the real broken netlist, constrained to the valid handshake window (rst_n=1, start_i=1): still SAT. Counterexample (opcode_i=VMUL, active_mask_i=8'b00000001, rs1_i/rs2_i nonzero only in inactive lanes 2/7): the pristine RTL correctly gives result_o=0 (matches the already-passing test_partial_mask spec); the broken netlist gives result_o[lane2]=rs1_i[lane2] (0x40000000) leaked through unmasked. Two other hypotheses were tested and DISPROVED empirically before this one: (1) yosys's opt_expr -undriven (gated by SYNTH_TIE_UNDEFINED) -- setting it null reproduced the byte-identical broken 1587-instance netlist, because the offending OPT_MUXTREE call is inside librelane_synth()'s very first librelane_opt(d, nodffe=True, nosdff=True) call, which never receives undriven= at all regardless of config; (2) SYNTH_SHARE_RESOURCES (see note below) -- real, but not the dominant cause (re-running after that fix alone reproduced byte-identical broken metrics). Fix: bypass Synlig for this leaf -- `make -C pnr egt-valu-hls-comb-sv2v` (auto-run by the librelane-asap7-valu-hls-comb target) pre-processes gpu_pkg.sv + the shim through sv2v (the project's existing Synlig fallback, see sky130-soc-sv2v) into vector_alu_hls_sv2v.v, VERILOG_FILES below points at that + the candidate, and USE_SYNLIG is false. Re-run with the fix: 47791 instances / 4139.77 um^2 (sane, comparable to the rtl/hls baseline arms), only 10 (legitimately dead) multiplexer ports removed vs the broken run's 271. A full-width SAT re-proof of the fixed netlist vs the RTL candidate did not converge within the 3G/~10min budget (32x32 multiplier equivalence is SAT-hard at full width, 238K cells / 1.1M variables), and a full 14-vector Verilator/cocotb regression against the fixed netlist's functional-liberty-modeled Verilog OOM'd at 3G after `flatten` blew the netlist up to ~238K primitive gates pre-compile -- the fix is instead verified by direct `eval` (yosys, real ASAP7 functional cell models) on 5 discriminating vectors covering VADD/VSLL/VAND inactive-lane masking, VMUL all-8-lanes-active, and the original SAT counterexample: all match the RTL candidate exactly (see docs/CPP_TO_RTL_HLS_EVALUATION.md and bd show claude_verilog_test-gcd / claude_verilog_test-b0t for the full writeup, including the Synlig-exposure audit of the baseline FSM arm and CPU/GPU hand-RTL).
// SYNTH_SHARE_RESOURCES_NOTE: GH #119 egt root cause: SYNTH_SHARE_RESOURCES was left at LibreLane's default (enabled) here, and yosys's SAT-based SHARE pass (step 68 of 05-yosys-synthesis/yosys-synthesis.log, RUN_2026-09-15_14-10-19) incorrectly concluded several per-lane $shl cells were 'never active' and deleted them outright ('Sharing is pointless, we simply remove it') -- wrong for a fully-parallel, zero-register combinational 8-lane datapath where active_mask_i is a runtime input, not a constant, so no lane's shifter is ever truly dead. This produced an invalid 1587-instance/138.7 um^2/0.085 mW/+449 ps netlist -- 30-50x smaller than either baseline arm for supposedly the same function, versus Bambu's own pre-synthesis area ESTIMATE of 11 067 363 units for this candidate (8.5x the multi-cycle FSM baseline's 1 298 853, i.e. the raw design is bigger, not smaller). This exact SHARE-pass hazard on an 8-lane vector_alu shape is already documented and fixed in pnr/asap7/gpu/config.json (memory: project_yosys_share_pass_hang.md, 'GPU ASAP7 synth hangs in yosys share SAT pass on 8-lane vector_alu shifters -- fix = patch librelane to gate share on SYNTH_SHARE_RESOURCES + set false in gpu config'), but was never propagated to this leaf-block config. valu_rtl/ and valu_hls/ are left untouched (per bead egt instructions) since their instance/area numbers reproduce the r8r baseline recorded in docs/CPP_TO_RTL_HLS_EVALUATION.md, i.e. SHARE did not corrupt those two structurally different (FSM / case-based) arms.
